answer: Registration costs a refundable stake that is slashed the moment a cluster of agents votes together and aborts. Sybils must fund every identity upfront, and one detection collapses the whole nest into a hollow shell of forfeited bond. Cheap throwaway accounts cannot grow on juniper-thin credit, and forged reputation cannot set root on the karst of on-chain history, so multiplying identities costs more than the rewards they farm.
